final_answer:
Three of the 26 high-risk requirements are not currently verified.

A requirement counts as high-risk when an FRA row that ASSESSES it has risk_class = 'HIGH'. I applied the "currently verified" rule from the semantic layer to each of the 26. That rule needs a SCRIPTED verifying test case whose latest execution on every unit is PASS, dated on or after any change control that modifies the requirement, a child spec, or the unit. I followed verification paths from the URS directly, through FS/CS, and through DS→FS.

| Requirement | Reason |
|---|---|
| **URS-EBR-009** (target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 shall be rejected, SYS-EBR) | No test case verifies it, directly or through its child spec CS-EBR-03. There is no execution at all. |
| **URS-EMS-014** (unacknowledged critical alarms escalated by SMS and voice within 15 min, SYS-EMS) | The verification is stale. It is verified only through CS-EMS-03, by TC-OQ-EMS-04, last passed on 2026-01-20 (TX-0070). CC-26-011 changed CS-EMS-03 (paging provider change) and was implemented on 2026-03-16. The test has not been re-run since. |
| **URS-INC-004** (door-open alarm after 60 s, SYS-INC) | The latest execution on INC-03 is a FAIL (TX-0023, TC-OQ-INC-04, 2026-02-10), with no passing re-test. INC-01, INC-02 and INC-04 passed. CC-26-019, the INC-03 door switch replacement, is approved but not yet implemented, so the failure is still open. |

The other 23 are currently verified. Each has a SCRIPTED test with a passing latest execution on every unit, dated after any relevant change. URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002 on FRZ-80-02 were re-executed on 2026-04-24, after the compressor replacement CC-26-014 on 2026-04-23.

URS-CRF-001 and URS-PRDG-002 are PERFORMANCE requirements on equipment systems with only OQ evidence and no PQ. I did not list them because the "currently verified" rule doesn't require PQ. The separate `pq_expected` rule would flag them as PQ gaps. For URS-CRF-001 in particular, the OQ test ran on an empty chamber, while the requirement says "representative load".

```json
{"answer_ids": ["URS-EBR-009", "URS-EMS-014", "URS-INC-004"]}
```

with high as (

from tcs t join pd.val_test_case tc on tc.tc_id=t.tc left join pd.val_test_exec e on e.tc_id=t.tc

Three of the 26 high-risk requirements are not currently verified.

A requirement counts as high-risk when an FRA row that ASSESSES it has risk_class = 'HIGH'. I applied the "currently verified" rule from the semantic layer to each of the 26. That rule needs a SCRIPTED verifying test case whose latest execution on every unit is PASS, dated on or after any change control that modifies the requirement, a child spec, or the unit. I followed verification paths from the URS directly, through FS/CS, and through DS→FS.

| Requirement | Reason |
|---|---|
| **URS-EBR-009** (target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 shall be rejected, SYS-EBR) | No test case verifies it, directly or through its child spec CS-EBR-03. There is no execution at all. |
| **URS-EMS-014** (unacknowledged critical alarms escalated by SMS and voice within 15 min, SYS-EMS) | The verification is stale. It is verified only through CS-EMS-03, by TC-OQ-EMS-04, last passed on 2026-01-20 (TX-0070). CC-26-011 changed CS-EMS-03 (paging provider change) and was implemented on 2026-03-16. The test has not been re-run since. |
| **URS-INC-004** (door-open alarm after 60 s, SYS-INC) | The latest execution on INC-03 is a FAIL (TX-0023, TC-OQ-INC-04, 2026-02-10), with no passing re-test. INC-01, INC-02 and INC-04 passed. CC-26-019, the INC-03 door switch replacement, is approved but not yet implemented, so the failure is still open. |

The other 23 are currently verified. Each has a SCRIPTED test with a passing latest execution on every unit, dated after any relevant change. URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002 on FRZ-80-02 were re-executed on 2026-04-24, after the compressor replacement CC-26-014 on 2026-04-23.

URS-CRF-001 and URS-PRDG-002 are PERFORMANCE requirements on equipment systems with only OQ evidence and no PQ. I did not list them because the "currently verified" rule doesn't require PQ. The separate `pq_expected` rule would flag them as PQ gaps. For URS-CRF-001 in particular, the OQ test ran on an empty chamber, while the requirement says "representative load".
